actions.description: Arm the Eiger for one externally triggered collection with the operator's DetectorParams: stage() runs the upstream arming chain unless the detector is armed
actions.name: stage

outputs.description: True when this call ran the arming chain; false when the detector was already armed and stage() did nothing
outputs.name: armed_here

actions.description: End the collection this connection staged: unstage() waits for the Odin writers, disarms the camera, checks Odin and disables ROI mode; without a staged collection only disarm_detector runs (staged false)
actions.name: unstage

outputs.description: True when a collection this connection staged was unstaged; false when only the camera acquire was cleared
outputs.name: staged

outputs.description: unstage's result: Odin initialised and no frame dropped or timed out; false without a staged collection
outputs.name: odin_ok

actions.description: Clear the Eiger camera acquire (disarm_detector) and report the resulting armed state
actions.name: disarm

outputs.description: False once the camera acquire is cleared
outputs.name: armed

actions.description: Publish, as one bounded ZIP artifact, the .h5 files Odin wrote for the acquisition id it reports: the regular files directly in DetectorParams.directory whose names start with the id and an underscore, once the detector is neither arming nor armed (is_armed) and every Odin writer reports Writing_RBV 0
actions.name: files

outputs.description: ZIP of the acquisition's files (manifest.json and files/<name>)
outputs.name: artifact_ref

outputs.description: The acquisition id the files belong to
outputs.name: acquisition_id

outputs.description: Number of files in the artifact
outputs.name: files

facts.text: EigerDetector is a classic ophyd Device that implements Stageable
cam is an EigerDetectorCam Component with the CAM: suffix and odin is an EigerOdin Component
stale_params and bit_depth are EpicsSignalRO Components on CAM:StaleParameters_RBV and CAM:BitDepthImage_RBV
detector_params is a class attribute that defaults to None
EigerTimeouts defaults to a 10 s general status timeout and a 60 s arming timeout; the i03 entry uses 20 s and 60 s
The constructor takes the beamline (default i03), uses that beamline's timeouts or the i03 ones, and sets disarming_status to None
set_detector_parameters stores the DetectorParams and raises when they are None or lack the detector size constants or the beam centre converter
async_stage sets disarming_status to None, clears Odin errors, raises when Odin is not initialised and starts the arming chain
is_armed returns true only when odin.fan.ready is 1 and cam.acquire is 1
stage waits for a started arming and, when the detector is not armed, waits up to the arming timeout for async_stage

unstage sets a new disarming_status, waits for arming, stops Odin after all frames in free-run mode, sets the file writer start timeout and waits 30 s for filewriters_finished; in a finally block it disarms, checks Odin's state and disables ROI mode; it finishes disarming_status and returns the Odin state only when no exception was raised

stop runs its cleanup only when disarming_status is None: it waits for any arming, stops Odin, sets the file writer start timeout, disarms the detector, disables ROI mode, waits for the combined status and turns off dev/shm streaming, and finishes disarming_status in a finally block
When disarming_status is set and not done, stop only waits for it up to the arming timeout and runs no cleanup
When disarming_status is set and done, stop only logs Already disarmed, doing nothing
change_roi_mode asserts detector_params is not None and, for a disable, sets roi_mode 0 and the image size and chunks of the file writer to the detector's full size

set_odin_pvs sets the Odin file path to DetectorParams.directory and the file name to full_filename, and returns a status that also waits for the meta listener file name and the acquisition id to report that name
_wait_fan_ready stores Odin's writers-finished status as filewriters_finished and returns a status that waits for the fan ready flag
disarm_detector clears cam.acquire and waits for the general status timeout

The arming chain asserts detector_params and runs Odin stop, dev/shm, threshold, camera, Odin, MX settings, trigger counts, stale parameters, Odin status, set_cam_acquire and the fan-ready wait without blocking
set_cam_pvs sets the camera trigger mode to EXTERNAL_SERIES
The meta listener's ready signal reads Writing_RBV and the file writer's id reads AcquisitionID_RBV
Each of the four Odin file-writer nodes has a writing signal on Writing_RBV
create_finished_status is done when the meta listener's ready and every node's writing equal 0
Odin stop sets the file writer capture to 0 and the meta listener stop_writing to 1
DetectorParams validates that directory is an existing directory and stores it with a trailing slash
run_number is a property: override_run_number when it is set, else get_run_number of the directory and prefix
get_run_number lists the directory's .nxs files that start with the prefix and returns 1 or the highest run number found plus 1
full_filename is the prefix and the run number joined by an underscore
beam_xy_converter builds a DetectorDistanceToBeamXYConverter from det_dist_to_beam_converter_path and the global config client
The converter reads its lookup table through the config client when it is built
The i03 module builds the classic EigerDetector with the EA-EIGER-01 prefix and builds the FastCS Eiger only with skip=True
The i03 config client is built from the URL in the CONFIG_SERVER_URL_ENV_VAR environment variable (or a default endpoint) and set as the global config client

measures.description: True when the Odin fan is ready and the camera acquire is on (is_armed)
measures.name: armed

measures.description: Odin's acquisition id (OD:AcquisitionID_RBV): the file-name prefix of the last armed collection
measures.name: acquisition_id

safe_state.description: Camera acquire cleared (disarm_detector runs after every e-stop); when the native stop() ran its cleanup with the operator's DetectorParams, Odin is also stopped, ROI mode disabled at full size and dev/shm streaming off (a stop() after an earlier stop or unstage only logs Already disarmed); a stop() or disarm that fails or exceeds the 1 s e-stop budget, or a stop() returning while an arming chain runs, reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, latched and retried
